bio.text: Shirley N. Weber has been California's Secretary of State since she was sworn into office on January 29, 2021, and was elected to a full term on November 8, 2022.
Before her appointment she served four terms in the California State Assembly, representing the 79th District, and served on and chaired the San Diego Unified School District board.
Born in Hope, Arkansas, she moved with her family to California at age three, earned her bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees at UCLA, and taught for 40 years at San Diego State University.
